title: Paid Antonym - Part (i) (SSC CGL 2018)

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.
TRANSIENT
questions.solution:
D) TRANSIENT(adjective) – Lasting only for a short time; temporary, fleeting, ephemeral.अल्पकालिक
Antonym:Permanent(adjective) – Lasting or intended to last indefinitely without change, enduring, everlasting.स्थायी

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.
LIBERTY
questions.solution:
A) LIBERTY(noun) – The state of being free within society from oppressive restrictions imposed by authority on one's way of life, behavior, or political views.स्वतंत्रता
Antonym:Slavery(noun) – The state of being a slave; a condition compared to that of a slave in respect of exhausting labor or restricted freedom.दासता

questions.question:
Select the antonym of the given word.
SOBER
questions.solution:
B) SOBER(adjective) – Marked by sedate or gravely or earnestly thoughtful character or demeanor. Not intoxicated or affected by the use of alcohol or drugs.गंभीर
Antonym:Agitated(adjective) – Disturbed or excited emotionally.परेशान

questions.question:
Select the antonym of the given word.
SWERVE
questions.solution:
D) SWERVE(verb) – To turn suddenly or deviate from a course, especially to avoid hitting something.मोड़ना
Antonym:Straighten(verb) – To make or become straight, to proceed in a direct course.सीधाकरना

questions.question:
Select the antonym of the given word.
DENSE
questions.solution:
A) DENSE(adjective) – Closely compacted in substance, thick, packed, crowded. घना
Antonym:Sparse(adjective) – Thinly dispersed or scattered, not thickly grown or settled, scanty. विरल

questions.question:
Select the antonym of the given word.
STALE
questions.solution:
B) Stale(adjective) – Not fresh, having a taste or smell that is no longer fresh, old, outdated.बासी
Antonym:Fresh(adjective) – Newly made or obtained, not stale or spoiled, recent, new.ताजा

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.
DEFICIT
questions.solution:
C) DEFICIT(noun) – A shortfall, lack, shortage, insufficiency.अभाव
Antonym:Surplus(noun) – An amount that is more than what is needed, excess, extra, remainder.अधिशेष

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.
ILLUMINATE
questions.solution:
D) ILLUMINATE(verb) – To light up, brighten, enlighten, clarify.प्रकाशितकरना
Antonym:Darken(verb) – To make or become dark, to shade, obscure, cloud.अंधेराकरना

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.
PUBLIC
questions.solution:
C) PUBLIC(adjective) – Open to or shared by all the people of an area or country, general, communal.सार्वजनिक
Antonym:Private(adjective) – Belonging to or for the use of one particular person or group of people only, not open or accessible to the public.निजी

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.
PROGRESSIVE
questions.solution:
A) PROGRESSIVE(adjective) – Forward-thinking, modern, innovative, advancing.प्रगतिशील
Antonym:Conservative(adjective) – Holding to traditional attitudes and values, opposed to change or innovation.पारंपरिक

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.
WEAKNESS
questions.solution:
B) WEAKNESS(noun) – The state or condition of lacking strength, feebleness, frailty, infirmity.दुर्बलता
Antonym:Strength(noun) – The quality or state of being physically strong, power, might, toughness.बल/शक्ति

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.
TYRANT
questions.solution:
B) TYRANT(noun) – A cruel and oppressive ruler, autocrat, despot, oppressor.अत्याचारी/तानाशाह
Antonym:Benefactor(noun) – A person who gives money or other help to a person or cause, donor, contributor, patron.उपकारी

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.
PROLONG
questions.solution:
B) PROLONG(verb) – To extend the duration of; lengthen, stretch out, continue.बढ़ाना
Antonym:Shorten(verb) – To make or become shorter in terms of time or length.छोटा करना

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.
SCANTY
questions.solution:
C) SCANTY(adjective) – Limited in quantity, insufficient, meager, sparse.अल्प
Antonym:Profuse(adjective) – Abundant, plentiful, copious, lavish.प्रचुर

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.
ABSURD
questions.solution:
C) ABSURD(adjective) – Ridiculous, foolish, nonsensical, illogical.अतर्कसंगत
Antonym:Sensible(adjective) – Reasonable, logical, rational, practical.तर्कसंगत

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.
ACQUIT
questions.solution:
D) ACQUIT(verb) – To declare someone free from blame, to exonerate, to absolve, to clear of a charge.दोषमुक्त करना
Antonym:Convict(verb) – To declare someone guilty of a crime, to find guilty, to condemn.दोषीठहराना

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.
ASCENT
questions.solution:
A) ASCENT(noun) – An upward movement, climb, rise.चढ़ाई
Antonym:Descent(noun) – A downward movement, drop, fall.उतार

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.
FOREIGN
questions.solution:
D) FOREIGN(adjective) – Of, from, in, or characteristic of a country or language other than one's own.विदेशी
Antonym:Native(adjective) – Associated with the country, region, or circumstances of a person's birth.स्वदेशी

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.
EXTRAVAGANT
questions.solution:
D) EXTRAVAGANT(adjective) – Spending much more than is necessary or wise; wasteful, profligate, lavish.अत्यधिक
Antonym:Thrifty(adjective) – Showing a careful use of money, especially by avoiding waste; frugal, economical.किफ़ायती

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.
VIGILANT
questions.solution:
B) VIGILANT(adjective) – Alert, watchful, attentive, on the lookout, cautious.सतर्क
Antonym:Careless(adjective) – Not giving sufficient attention or thought to avoiding harm or errors, negligent, heedless, inattentive.लापरवाह
